remarks: Welcome to The Kingswood, a beautifully maintained Active Adult 55+ community. Enjoy this bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath unit on the 3rd floor, where natural light fills each room. Recently installed designer laminate flooring, shiny stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, and freshly painted interior. Conveniently located assigned parking space just steps away from the rear patio area. Rent includes heat, A/C, water, and electric, making living here truly carefree. The Kingswood offers fantastic amenities like a fully equipped fitness center, cozy community room with gas fireplace and pool table, a movie theater/business center, and a sunny courtyard patio with a grilling area-perfect for relaxing outdoors. Enjoy regularly scheduled monthly events including bingo, social hours, holiday parties, Rummikub and poker. Truly something for everyone! Located close to I-95, public transportation, downtown Stamford, Darien shops, and dining. Welcome to The Kingswood-the lifestyle you deserve!
